title: Mouse wheel over the Mark dropdown can set CF and permanently stop the session with no confirmation
detail: Four wheel notches move C -> D -> NYC -> NA -> CF with autosave; the record becomes STOPPED / Not yet competent and stays so after the mark is changed back.
action: Fix, add a DT regression test, then `jev verify --issue JEV-0001`.

title: Typing a truck make key by key saves a corrupted value (KENWORTH becomes KENWORTHWORTH)
detail: The field holds KENWORTHWORTH ('Ken' gives 'KenT KENWORTH'), and DT records that value.
action: Fix, add a DT regression test, then `jev verify --issue JEV-0002`.

title: Cancel report request does nothing while an AI draft is being requested
detail: The click is ignored until the provider answers.
action: Fix, add a DT regression test, then `jev verify --issue JEV-0003`.

title: The unlock dialog shows raw system errors ([Errno 2] No such file or directory, [Errno 36] File name too long)
detail: 'Could not open records' shows Python's OSError text with the full path, e.g. [Errno 2] No such file or directory: '<folder>/vault.lock'.
action: Fix, add a DT regression test, then `jev verify --issue JEV-0009`.

title: Cancel registration check does nothing while the NHVR request is running
detail: The click is ignored until NHVR answers.
action: Fix, add a DT regression test, then `jev verify --issue JEV-0004`.

title: After Check video file finishes, the file selection is cleared, so the next evidence action fails
detail: The evidence list is rebuilt with nothing selected and the next button warns 'Select an imported file first'.
action: Fix, add a DT regression test, then `jev verify --issue JEV-0005`.

title: Backing up into the vault folder fails with a generic message that hides the reason
detail: The status says 'Operation failed. Check destination space, file access and evidence integrity.'
action: Fix, add a DT regression test, then `jev verify --issue JEV-0006`.

title: Help guide says video playback is not built in, but Evidence has in-app playback and clipping
detail: It says 'Watch the recording in your video player ... Playback is not built into this version.' and to ask support to configure FFmpeg.
action: Fix, add a DT regression test, then `jev verify --issue JEV-0007`.

title: Checking a damaged video shows raw FFprobe output (moov atom not found, memory addresses, internal paths)
detail: The status bar shows 'FFprobe could not read this file: [mov,mp4,... @ 0x55e5...] moov atom not found <vault>/work/<id>.mp4: Invalid data found when processing input'.
action: Fix, add a DT regression test, then `jev verify --issue JEV-0010`.

title: Module builder clears the module selection after excluding it, so Restore needs a reselect
detail: The selection is cleared; Restore warns 'Select an included module in the Modules tab'.
action: Fix, add a DT regression test, then `jev verify --issue JEV-0008`.
